focus: پیشرفته ۱ · جلسه هفتم · سؤال‌واژه وسط جمله

sentences.fa: کار مهمي برام پيش اومده، مي شه اين نامه ها رو به رييسم برسوني؟
sentences.en: Something important has come up to me, could you take these letters over to my boss?
But I don't know what he looks like.
He is about your brother's height.
He is about your mother's height.
He is about your son's height.
Ok, I think, I can recognize him.
Do you think you can recognize him?
His face has been burnt, I can't recognize him.

sentences.fa: فکر مي کني بتوني تشخيصش بدي؟
sentences.en: Do you think you can recognize him?

sentences.fa: نمي تونم انگليسي رو از فرانسه تشخيص بدم.
sentences.en: He can't distinguish English from French.

sentences.fa: مي توني خوب رو از بد تشخيص بدي؟
sentences.en: Can you distinguish good from bad?

sentences.fa: نمي تونه خوب رو از بد تشخيص بده چه برسه ازدواج کنه.
sentences.en: He can't distinguish good from bad let alone get marry.

sentences.fa: نمي تونم پول بدست بيارم چه برسه شرکت رو بچرخونم.
sentences.en: I can't earn money let alone run the company.

sentences.fa: بيماري شما را سرطان تشخيص دادم.
sentences.en: I have diagnosed your disease the cancer.

sentences.fa: بيماري شما سرطان تشخيص داده شده است.
sentences.en: Your disease has been diagnosed the cancer.
Thanks very much, it kind of you.
It's kind of you to say that.

sentences.fa: از لطف شماست که اين پول رو بهم قرض دادي.
sentences.en: It's kind of you to lend me this money.

sentences.fa: يادت مي آد جلسه قبل چي گفتم؟
sentences.en: Do you remember what I told you last session?

words.en: It's kind of you/it's nice of you/ it's good of you

proverb.fa: کافر همه را به کيش خود پندارد.
proverb.en: Every mad man thinks of every other man mad.
